title: Routes 19–20 & Seafoam Islands
subtitle: Surf south from Fuchsia, boulder puzzle, Articuno

steps.text: You need Surf (Soul Badge) and Strength (Rainbow Badge) here. Bring an Electric or Grass type for the swimmers' Water teams.
Route 19: surf south from Fuchsia past a crowd of Swimmers. Tentacool everywhere; Horsea, Krabby, Staryu (LG) by rod.
Route 20 east: more Swimmers, then the Seafoam Islands entrance.

Seafoam Islands: push the two boulders on 1F into the holes, then the two on B1F, so they fall to B3F/B4F and stop the current. Zubat, Golbat, Psyduck, Slowpoke, Seel, Krabby; Jynx and Dewgong in the deeper floors.
B4F: Articuno Lv.50 (Ice/Flying). One-time: save, use Rock/Electric/Fire to whittle, sleep it, Ultra Balls. Weak to Rock ×4.
Exit and surf west along Route 20 to Cinnabar Island.
